bibl.title: Dating Early Christian Papyri: Old and New Methods - Introduction.
bibl.seg: Roberta Mazza, Dating Early Christian Papyri: Old and New Methods - Introduction.
Journal for the Study of the New Testament 42 (2019) pp. 46-57.
bibl.note: Introduces papers from an SBL panel (San Antonio, Texas, Nov. 21, 2016) on the state of the art of palaeographical and other methodologies used for assigning a date to papyrus manuscripts that do not contain any indication of their time of composition other than their material aspect.
